title: ClaimIdentity
description: Email-anchored player identity. Source: docs/EDD.md §4.2; docs/SCHEMA.md §2.1 claim_identities. Renamed from a Mermaid-generic 'User' label (commit 56f64fa). Raw email is never stored — only the SHA-256 hash and AES-256-GCM ciphertext.

emailHash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the lowercased email. UNIQUE — used as the lookup key for claim retries.

emailEncrypted.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the email. Set to NULL within 7 days of a GDPR deletion request.

deletionRequestedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the data subject submitted a GDPR erasure request. NULL = no pending erasure.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp when the identity row was created (first claim).
